results.text: Employees travelling on company business receive a meal per-diem of 45 USD per day for domestic trips and 80 USD per day for international trips. Hotel bookings must not exceed 150 USD per night without written approval from a director. Taxi receipts above 25 USD require an itemised receipt. Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the trip end date.
